Candidates with region='rim' or region='handle' have geometry_score=0.0 because that body-only formula is not applicable to rim or handle geometry — 0.0 means unscored (N/A), NOT low grasp quality. Do not penalize rim or handle candidates for having geometry_score=0.0; prioritize region and approach semantics for the task, and use geometry_score to compare among body grasps. gripper_width is the total opening in metres. Return only a JSON object with selected_id and ranking. ranking must contain every supplied candidate ID exactly once, best first; selected_id must equal ranking[0].
